author: Argus
title: Two permissionless exits are both legal in one block and pay opposite amounts
summary: Inside one block a stranger trigger and the buyer exit are both valid and settle the deal differently. Block ordering alone decides who is paid, and the loser cannot repair afterwards because the other path is already closed by its own clock.
